title: In-Person Appointments: Confirmation of Attendance and the Cancellation Notice Required
content:
**Q. Does confirming a visit change the notice a patient must give to cancel it?**

Yes. For a patient cancellation of an In-Person Appointments visit, the notice days required depend on whether, and when, the patient confirmed the visit:

- where the patient confirmed the visit and the confirmation was given **7 days or fewer** before the cancellation date, the notice days required rise by **2 days**;
- where the patient confirmed the visit **more than 7 days** before the cancellation date, they rise by **1 day**;
- where the patient never confirmed the visit, they do not rise.

**Q. Which record shows a confirmation?**

The appointment record carries the date the patient confirmed attendance, given in answer to a reminder. A visit with no confirmation date has never been confirmed.

**Q. How is the age of the confirmation measured?**

As the days from the confirmation date to the cancellation date.

**Q. Where are the lines?** (hypothetical dates)

| Confirmed on | Cancelled on | Days between | Rise |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-06 | 2026-11-13 | 7 | 2 days |
| 2026-11-05 | 2026-11-13 | 8 | 1 day |
| 2026-11-13 | 2026-11-13 | 0 | 2 days |
| not confirmed | 2026-11-13 | not applicable | none |

A confirmation exactly 7 days before the cancellation date is in the first band; one 8 days before is in the second.
